names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 27 Δεκεμβρίου, «Άγιος Θεόδωρος ο Α' Αρχιεπίσκοπος Κωνσταντινούπολης», with the rank, the ordinal and the see left off.

Name page of days.pravoslavie.ru for this memory is «Святитель Феодор I Константинопольский, патриарх»: «Святитель» and «патриарх» are rank words and are stripped, and the numeral is kept because the calendar prints it and it is what tells him from the day’s other Theodore. `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE; the folder had no Cyrillic form of any kind.

death.note: saint.gr's head for the entry gives «Αγιος Θεοδωρος ο Α' Αρχιεπισκοπος Κωνσταντινουπολης (; - 687)» — no year of birth, and 687 as the closing year. The page's text gives the same year as the end of his patriarchate, «πατριάρχευσε έως το 687 μ.Χ.», and says of his end only «απεβίωσε ειρηνικά», without a year of its own; 687 is therefore the page's own figure in its head and not a year this reading computed. The page places his life under Constantine IV Pogonatos, «(668 - 685 μ.Χ.)».

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 27 декабря ст. ст. — «Свт. Феодора , архиеп. Константинопольского (ок. 686).»

attestations.note: The day’s fourth entry and the same menologion day, 27 December, as the folder’s Greek row, which is its only other venerated row. The line says «архиеп.», archbishop, and the name page «патриарх», patriarch; both are what the folder’s `types` and its `office` «Archbishop and Patriarch of Constantinople» already hold, so neither was changed. The numeral on the name page, «Феодор I», is what separates him from the other Theodore on this same day, the Branded. NO `dates` WERE WRITTEN: the line’s «ок. 686» is about 686 and the folder already carries its own reading. The reading life3187 was NOT OPENED. The day page prints four hymns, three for the protomartyr Stephen and one for the venerable Theodore, and none for this hierarch.
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (2 October 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 27ης Δεκεμβρίου — «Άγιος Θεόδωρος ο Α' Αρχιεπίσκοπος Κωνσταντινούπολης»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 27 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. He is not to be confused with the other Theodore of this day, Θεόδωρος ο Γραπτός, who has his own page and whose folder the corpus already keeps: the two are separate entries in saint.gr's listing and separate men. The page cross-refers two patriarchs the corpus holds — «ο τότε Πατριάρχης Κωνσταντίνος (βλέπε 9 Αυγούστου)» and «ο πατρός Γεωργίου Α' (βλέπε 18 Αυγούστου)» — and both those folders carry a venerated Greek row on exactly those days, which is what makes the two `related` rows. It names Hagia Sophia and Constantinople but no coordinate is proposed. It prints no hymn, and closes by sending the reader to «Σύναξη πάντων των εν Αγίοις Πατέρων ημών Αρχιεπισκόπων και Πατριαρχών Κωνσταντινουπόλεως», which is a synaxis heading and not drafted. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs (2 October 2026).
